# Angles and set

## Rule

On the ball-to-centre-goal line. Set before the shot. Feet quiet. Hands ready. Do not dive early. Do not collapse the set because the shot looks hard.

## Cue

Shot is on. Plant. Make yourself big. The dive is a last resort, not a default.

## Seen in us

_None yet._
